description: This file defines the MainWindow class for a WPF application, handling window state, WebView2 initialization, and WebView2 runtime installation prompts.

classes.name: MainWindow
classes.description: Main application window class for Focalboard, managing WebView2 setup, window state, and user prompts.

methods.name: MainWindow
methods.description: Constructor initializing the main window, restoring state, and setting up WebView.

methods.name: MainWindow_Loaded
methods.description: Event handler for when the window is loaded, activates the window.

methods.name: PromptToInstallWebview2
methods.description: Prompts user to install WebView2 runtime if not present.

methods.name: Installer_InstallProgress
methods.description: Handles progress updates during WebView2 installer download and installation.

methods.name: Installer_InstallCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of WebView2 installation, reopens window if needed.

methods.name: SaveWindowState
methods.description: Saves current window position, size, and state to settings.

methods.name: RestoreWindowsState
methods.description: Restores window position, size, and maximized state from settings.

methods.name: MainWindow_Closing
methods.description: Handles window closing event to save state.

methods.name: InitializeWebView
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes WebView2 environment and loads the web app.

methods.name: GetWebView2Version
methods.description: Retrieves the installed WebView2 runtime version.

methods.name: WebView_ContentLoading
methods.description: Sets session ID in WebView2 local storage when content loads.
